findings.problem: On the phone frame the moving line's label "c = 5" runs into the "x = −1" label at the top of the sketch, so neither label can be read while the voice says "Above four, it does not intersect either".
findings.fix: Place the y = c label where it cannot meet the x = −1 label at every height it slides to, for example at the right end of the line, so both labels stay clear and readable at phone size.

findings.problem: The deciding step of the explanation is only spoken: "every line below four intersects it" (beat 17) and "C equals four is allowed" (beat 18). The board goes straight from y < 4 to the boxed c ≥ 4, so a student does not see why c < 4 is ruled out.
findings.fix: Write a short line as each is said, for example "c < 4: intersects" on "every line below four intersects it" and "c ≥ 4: does not intersect" on "C equals four is allowed", then box c ≥ 4 as now.
